config.corpus: full eligible official FSD50K train split, minus a fixed withheld slice
config.identity: P-LT-50k is the full-corpus P-LT recipe for 50,000 steps. Calibrated anchored Perceiver. Global NT-Xent plus masked local only. No L_time. Random init, not a resume of the 5,000-step P-LT-F checkpoint. The learning-rate schedule is built for 50,000 steps. A small fixed slice of the train split is withheld for pretraining loss only.

schedule.formula: Warmup is max(1, T // 20) steps. Step t in warmup uses base_lr * (t + 1) / warmup. After warmup, cosine decay runs from base_lr to min_lr with progress (t - warmup) / (T - warmup), so the decay is built for this T and reaches the end of the run.

withhold.rule: Sort the eligible train split by freesound id. Withhold every index divisible by 64. Those recordings are not sampled for training.
